Other additional Criteria with our Bank

0.10% additional commission for takeover cases.
0.10% additional commission only for individual proposal of Rs.5.00 Cr & above.
Additional commission (1+2) should not exceed 0.10%.
Payout will be exclusive of GST.
Payout will be credited on disbursal of at least 20% of the loan amount.
If the disbursement amount is less than 90% sanctioned loan amount, then proportionate payout will be recovered for undisbursed loan amount from future payout of DSAs.
If the Loan amount is more than Rs.15.00 Cr & up to Rs.50.00 Cr then, an additional payout of Rs.0.30% to be provided on the incremental loan amount above Rs.15.00 Cr, subject to a maximum payout of Rs.20.00 Lakh per proposal.
If the loan amount is Rs.50.00 Cr and above, for additional loan amount of above Rs.15.00 Cr, An additional payout of 0.30% to be provided on the incremental loan amount above Rs.15.00 Cr, subject to a maximum payout of Rs.40.00 Lakh per proposal.
Recovery of DSA payout during the Claw Back Period:

100% recover if the account is taken over within one year from the date of first disbursement.
50% recover if the account is taken over within Two years and after completion of 1 year from the date of first disbursement.
25% recover if the account is taken over within Three years and after completion of 2 years from the date of first disbursement.
In case the account becomes impaired within one year (Quick Mortality Account) 100% recovery of commission shall be made from DSA.
